responsibility: Declares the typechecker-facing abstractions that wrap resolved HIR traits. TraitItemReference models one associated function/const/type together with its HIR node, substitutions, Self context, and associated-type state; TraitReference models a trait plus its items, super traits, and generic substitutions; and AssociatedImplTrait records the link between a trait, an impl block, and its self type so associated types can be set up for that implementation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the in-memory representations used after trait resolution—TraitItemReference, TraitReference, and AssociatedImplTrait—and the operations they expose to the typechecker. Unlike rust-hir-trait-reference.cc, it introduces these wrapper types but does not implement lookup, object-safety, or associated-type update behavior.
